name: ankyrin repeat domain 26
pathways: negative regulation of fat cell differentiation

function.text: ANKRD26 encodes ankyrin repeat domain-containing protein 26. It participates in negative regulation of fat cell differentiation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to thrombocytopenia 2 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
